waiver.name: Application to Proceed In Forma Pauperis (Family Court)

residency.text: Either spouse must have actually resided (been domiciled) in Delaware, or been stationed there in the armed forces, continuously for 6 or more months immediately before filing (13 Del. C. § 1504(a); § 1503(1)).

waitingPeriod.text: No waiting period after filing, but the no-fault grounds of voluntary separation, mental illness or incompatibility require living separate and apart for 6 or more months before the court rules on the petition (13 Del. C. § 1503(8), § 1505(b)); no separation period for misconduct.

parentingClass.text: Where there are living children of the marriage up to age 17, the court shall order the parties to pay for and attend a certified Parenting Education Course unless the court finds it unnecessary (13 Del. C. § 1507(h)).
